sources.snippet: Model Description: vietnamese-embedding is the Embedding Model for Vietnamese language. This model is a specialized sentence-embedding trained specifically for the Vietnamese language, leveraging the robust capabilities of PhoBERT, a pre-trained language model based on the RoBERTa architecture.

sources.snippet: Overview Vietnamese_Embedding is a sentence transformer model fine-tuned from BAAI/bge-m3 to optimize semantic search and document retrieval for Vietnamese text. Developed by AITeamVN, the model encodes Vietnamese sentences and documents into a 1024-dimensional dense vector space using dot product similarity for ranking.
